changed.title: COTC033: Repurposing Vaccine Immunity to Treat Cancers

before.eligibilitySummary: Dogs 15-60 kg with confirmed solid tumors 2-8 cm, excluding mast cell tumors, cutaneous hemangiosarcomas, thyroid carcinomas, and lymphomas. No prior experimental therapy and various treatment washout periods required.
before.eligibilityDetails: Body weight between 15 and 60 kg. Tumor biopsy or cytology to confirm diagnosis. Solid tumor measuring 2 to 8 cm. No mast cell tumors, cutaneous hemangiosarcomas, thyroid carcinomas, or lymphomas. Must not have received ANY prior experimental therapy. No concurrent chemotherapy or radiation therapy – 2 week washout period required. No concurrent immunomodulatory therapy (including Apoquel or Cytopoint) – 6 week washout period required. No concurrent corticosteroids – 1 week washout period required. No hypercalcemia causing illness. No significant co-morbid illness including pulmonary metastatic disease, renal or hepatic failure, history of congestive heart failure or clinical coagulopathy, autoimmune disorders, or uncontrolled endocrinopathies.

after.conditionSpecific: solid tumors (non-mast cell, non-hemangiosarcoma, non-thyroid, non-lymphoma)
after.eligibilitySummary: Dogs 15-60 kg with cytologically or histologically confirmed solid tumors measuring 2-8 cm, excluding mast cell tumors, hemangiosarcomas, thyroid carcinomas, and lymphomas. No prior experimental therapy allowed.
after.eligibilityDetails: Body weight between 15 and 60 kg; Tumor biopsy or cytology to confirm diagnosis; Solid tumor measuring 2 to 8 cm; No mast cell tumors, cutaneous hemangiosarcomas, thyroid carcinomas, or lymphomas; Must not have received ANY prior experimental therapy; No concurrent chemotherapy or radiation therapy – 2 week washout period required; No concurrent immunomodulatory therapy (including Apoquel or Cytopoint) – 6 week washout period required; No concurrent corticosteroids – 1 week washout period required; No hypercalcemia causing illness; No significant co-morbid illness, which includes, but is not limited to: pulmonary metastatic disease, renal or hepatic failure, history of congestive heart failure or clinical coagulopathy, autoimmune disorders, or uncontrolled endocrinopathies.

At least two peripheral lymph nodes ≥2 cm in longest diameter. WHO stage II, III, or IV B-cell lymphoma. Adequate organ function on bloodwork and urinalysis. Performance score of 0-1 and life expectancy ≥1 month. Owner consent. Exclusions: T-cell lymphoma or involvement of skin, GI tract, or nervous system. Internal-only disease without peripheral lymph node enlargement. Prior lymphoma treatment or long-term corticosteroids (>2 weeks). Hypercalcemia, MDR1 deficiency, pregnancy/lactation, or concurrent trial enrollment.

after.eligibilitySummary: Dogs 1+ years old, 10-50 kg, with newly diagnosed, untreated B-cell lymphoma confirmed by cytology/histology with immunophenotyping, at least two peripheral lymph nodes ≥2 cm, WHO stage II-IV, adequate organ function, and performance score 0-1.
after.eligibilityDetails: Dogs >1 year old and 10–50 kg in body weight; Naïve, untreated B-cell lymphoma confirmed by cytology or histology with immunophenotyping (flow cytometry); At least two peripheral lymph nodes ≥2 cm in longest diameter; WHO stage II, III, or IV B-cell lymphoma; Adequate organ function on bloodwork and urinalysis; Performance score of 0–1 (normal to mildly decreased activity) and life expectancy ≥1 month; Owner consent. Key exclusions: T-cell lymphoma or involvement of skin, GI tract, or nervous system; Internal-only disease (mediastinum, liver, spleen) without peripheral lymph node enlargement; Prior lymphoma treatment (chemotherapy, Tanovea, Laverdia, radiation) or long-term corticosteroids (>2 weeks); Hypercalcemia, MDR1 deficiency, pregnancy/lactation, or concurrent trial enrollment.
